lines.text: Many learners say: She is in charge for the project.
Better: She is in charge of the project.
Use in charge of, not in charge for.
Of! She is in charge of the project.

data.wrong: She is in charge for the project.
data.right: She is in charge of the project.
data.why: Use in charge of, not in charge for.

quiz.stem: She is in charge ___ the project.
